conventions.feature_granularity: One catalog item and one Markdown file per independently implementable syntax feature, module, data-form capability, API method, site-structure behavior, layout behavior, or platform/runtime capability.
conventions.authority: The files are exhaustive extractions of the frozen documentation corpus. They are not claims that the snapshot is complete or correct. Reproducible live Wikidot behavior overrides a conflicting documentation claim.
conventions.partial_documentation: invocation-only, high-level-documentation, and partially-documented items require live-oracle evidence before unspecified behavior is invented.
